signals.usability_note: Clear daytime view of a residential frontage. The main subject appears to be the two-story gray house with green stone/shingle lower facade and an attached two-car garage. A neighboring tan house is visible at left.

professional_landscaping.evidence: Front has stone-edged planting beds with landscape rocks and shrubs, and the lawn is mowed, but there is no crew, equipment, or other crew-level evidence.

signals.notes: Wooded lot with a large front lawn and rock-bordered garden beds; the roof is largely obscured by trees and the driveway area is partly hidden.
